posts.title: PR Elsewhere
posts.description: PR Elsewhere is a Chrome extension that adds a View in menu to GitHub pull requests, and it's now on the Chrome Web Store.

posts.title: Introducing astro-entry-meta: drafts, reading time and git info for Astro collections
posts.description: A new package that adds drafts, scheduled posts, reading time and git info to Astro content collections, and replaces astro-git-dates.

posts.title: Watts Up
posts.description: Watts Up is a Raycast extension that shows your MacBook's charger wattage, charging power and battery health, and it's now on the Raycast store.
